b_condition: Z_2^times is an open subset of Q_2
fixed_a_condition: already satisfied by the chosen odd a
identity: Phi_1^{2} on this base is a in 1+2Z_2 and b in Z_2^times
important_distinction: b in Phi is a local open condition; demanding b=eps*f*Q with Q prime in a fixed progression is not.  A surface weak-approximation theorem would only need the former, which is the original existential condition.
label: PROVED

endpoint_normalization: H_0=H_8=(A*a^4*Z^2)^2, so the scalar in a conjugate factorization is a rational square and can be absorbed into E,O
equivalences: P(u^2/2) factors over Q as two degree-8 factors exchanged by u->-u
H=(A/4)P has a representation H=E(b)^2-2b*O(b)^2 with E in Q[b], deg E<=4, and O in Q[b], deg O<=3
exact_arithmetic_locus: for H=sum(h_k b^k), it is the projection of h_k=sum_{i+j=k}e_i e_j-2 sum_{i+j=k-1}o_i o_j (0<=k<=8), with E=sum_{0..4}e_i b^i and O=sum_{0..3}o_i b^i
label: PROVED
premise: P is irreducible of degree 8 and theta=b mod P
warning: theta is the algebraic root of P; the rational Phi variable b is not being substituted into this field criterion

choice_of_a: the residues with (1+4a^2|w)=-1 occur in nonzero +/- pairs; choose one not congruent to 1 mod w, then CRT with a odd
conclusion: the degree-one w-adic place theta->beta makes 2theta nonsquare; therefore 2theta is not a square in K
label: PROVED

odd_target_valuation_case.conclusion: a place above w has ord(theta)=3e odd, so 2theta is nonsquare
odd_target_valuation_case.hypothesis: e=v_w(z) is odd; no condition on s
odd_target_valuation_case.residual: endpoint quartic is separable because w is odd

residual_scope: for a pre-existing class with v_w(z) even and w|s this target-prime proof is OPEN; only the separately replayed per-row certificates apply
uniform_scope: every fixed cell after refining the existing L20 choice by a not congruent to 1 mod w and applying the proved L22 HIT selection inside that progression; no new branch parameter

effect_at_simple_value_primes: it changes the odd-valuation Hilbert sign to (j|R); it does not make the octic fibre split and does not force that sign to +1
label: PROVED
norm_identity_no_go: if also P=c*(E^2-j*O^2) with c in Q^times, then at theta, E(theta)/O(theta)=sqrt(j) lies in K (O(theta)!=0 by deg O<8). Thus j is a square in K, and 2theta/j square would imply 2theta square, contradicting the target-prime lemma
twisted_capell: 2theta/j square in K iff P(j*u^2/2) has the conjugate degree-8 factorization
without_norm_identity: requiring every odd value-prime R to satisfy (j|R)=+1 is the same Chebotarev half-sieve condition, not a Dirichlet-only replacement
